behavior_before: The legacy current-weather path persisted success audits on a separate connection from observations, and a failed per-location insert could leave the shared transaction unusable for later locations.
behavior_after: Each location write and success audit now share one database transaction/savepoint. A location failure rolls back only that location before its failure audit is written on the shared connection; projection failure rolls back observations and audits together.
focused_test_command: python3 -m pytest tests/test_weather_legacy_atomicity.py tests/test_weather_legacy_error_redaction.py tests/test_weather_worker.py tests/test_weather_cli_scope.py tests/test_weather_cli_parity.py tests/test_worker_operation_map.py tests/test_worker_job_contract_inventory.py -q
new_regressions: a failed location write rolls back to its savepoint, writes a same-connection failure audit, and allows a later location to commit
a ClickHouse outbox/projection failure rolls back the observation and its same-transaction success audit
remaining_limitations: Legacy retry can still insert a duplicate PostgreSQL observation because the compatibility path has no source watermark or receipt. The native signed weather worker remains default-off, and persisted task/schedule ownership still needs reconciliation.
